node_notes.mpu_drv: This driver validates the MPU identity, configures its registers, and converts accelerometer counts into g values. firmware/drivers/mpu6050/mpu6050.c calls the platform read and write callbacks for those transactions.
node_notes.app: The application coordinates initialization, sensing, ride-event handling, display updates, and telemetry in app_start. Its calls to platform_io and the services are in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.display: This service manages OLED initialization, splash timing, dashboard rendering, and event text. It uses platform_io and SH1106 driver APIs in firmware/services/display.c.
node_notes.dht_drv: This driver checks the five-byte DHT frame checksum and converts the readings to engineering units. The decoding and range validation are in firmware/drivers/dht22/dht22.c.
node_notes.ride: This module detects ride events from acceleration samples and computes the alert LED state. The application invokes its sampling and update functions from firmware/modules/ride_events.c.
node_notes.uart: USART2 carries diagnostic logs and queued telemetry, with TX on PA2 and RX on PA3 at the configured baud rate. firmware/configs/app_config.h supplies the pin and baud values, and firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_io.c initializes and writes the peripheral.
node_notes.telemetry: This service formats snapshots and ride events as VPD1 CSV and queues records at APP_TELEMETRY_PERIOD_MS. The formatting and timing gate are in firmware/services/telemetry.c.
node_notes.i2c: I2C1 is the shared serial bus for the MPU6050 and SH1106, with SCL on PB8 and SDA on PB9. The pin assignments and I2C1 setup are established by app_config.h and firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_io.c.
node_notes.oled_drv: This driver sends SH1106 initialization commands and framebuffer pages through a supplied send callback. Its page and enable operations are defined in firmware/drivers/sh1106/sh1106.c.
node_notes.dht: The DHT22 data line is connected to PB4 and is driven and sampled as a timed single-wire exchange. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_io.c implements platform_io_dht_frame on APP_DHT_PIN.
node_notes.oled: The SH1106 display is addressed at 0x3C and receives initialization and page data over I2C. The address and display operations are in firmware/services/display.c and firmware/drivers/sh1106/sh1106.c.
node_notes.mpu: The MPU6050 is the motion-sensing device accessed at address 0x68. Its address is configured by APP_MPU_ADDRESS and its transactions use the I2C1 bus in firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_io.c.
node_notes.console: This is the serial output sink for application logs and telemetry bytes sent through USART2. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_io.c uses HAL_UART_Transmit for logs and LL_USART_TransmitData8 for queued telemetry.
node_notes.led: The indicator output is PA5 and its logical polarity is translated using the board LED helper. firmware/configs/app_config.h defines the pin and firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_io.c drives it with HAL_GPIO_WritePin.
node_notes.platform: This STM32 I/O owner configures the buses and pins, performs device transfers, controls PA5, and handles UART output. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_io.c uses HAL I2C, HAL GPIO, HAL UART, and LL USART APIs.
node_notes.sensors: This service schedules MPU and DHT reads, qualifies IMU calibration, and maintains the shared snapshot used by the application. Its timing and data flow are implemented in firmware/services/sensors.c.

node_notes.accel_valid: The application submits a real acceleration sample only when the snapshot marks it valid; otherwise it submits NULL to reset ride sample history. The branch is in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.display_ready: Display processing is skipped when display initialization failed. The guard is in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.init_services: After I/O setup, the application initializes the display and sensors and sets up ride-event state. These calls are in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.begin: app_start starts the generated live telemetry component before setting up the application state. This call appears at the beginning of firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.process_telemetry: The application passes the current time, snapshot, and event to the telemetry formatter each iteration. The 200 ms send gate is defined by APP_TELEMETRY_PERIOD_MS in firmware/configs/app_config.h and checked in firmware/services/telemetry.c.
node_notes.process_sensors: The loop processes scheduled sensor reads and obtains the latest shared readings snapshot. Both calls are in firmware/app/app.c, with sampling logic in firmware/services/sensors.c.
node_notes.display_active: Ride-event processing is gated on a ready display that is no longer showing the splash screen. This condition is in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.event_changed: Only a change from the previous event updates the display event text and logs the selection. The comparison is in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.sample_invalid: When acceleration is invalid, the application passes NULL to ride_events_sample. That behavior is in firmware/app/app.c and clears the retained sample count in firmware/modules/ride_events.c.
node_notes.init_io: The application initializes its STM32 I/O layer before using sensors or the display. The call to platform_io_init is in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.init_fail: A failed platform_io_init ends app_start before entering its main loop. The early return is in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.report_event: On an event change, the application sets the display message and writes the relevant selection log through platform_io_log. These actions are in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.update_event: The application updates the selected ride event and computes whether the alert LED should be on. It calls ride_events_update in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.io_ok: The firmware returns early if platform I/O setup fails, so normal execution only starts after successful initialization. This branch follows the platform_io_init result in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.process_display: When initialized, the display service advances its splash or dashboard state using current readings. The call is in firmware/app/app.c and the state handling is in firmware/services/display.c.
node_notes.poll: Each cooperative iteration polls generated telemetry, reads the platform time, and services platform I/O. The sequence is in the app_start loop in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.sample_accel: A valid acceleration snapshot is copied into a ride_sample_t and submitted to the event detector. This code is in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.set_led: The application passes the current alert state to the platform LED API on each loop iteration. This call is in firmware/app/app.c and is implemented with PA5 writes in firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_io.c.

sequence.title: Sequence Diagram
sequence.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Boot as Core main
  participant App as app_start
  participant IO as platform_io
  participant Sensors as sensors service
  participant I2C as I2C1 PB8 PB9
  participant MPU as MPU6050
  participant DHT as DHT22 PB4
  participant Ride as ride_events
  participant Display as display service
  participant OLED as SH1106
  participant Telemetry as telemetry service
  participant UART as USART2 PA2 PA3
  participant Console as UART console

  Boot->>App: Call app_start
  App->>Telemetry: firmgen_telemetry_start with UART handle
  App->>IO: platform_io_init
  IO->>UART: Configure USART2 and initialize HAL UART
  IO->>I2C: Configure I2C1 on PB8 and PB9
  App->>Display: display_init
  Display->>OLED: Initialize SH1106 and clear pages
  OLED->>IO: Send display commands over platform_io_transmit
  IO->>I2C: I2C master transfers
  App->>Sensors: sensors_init
  Sensors->>MPU: Initialize and verify device registers
  MPU->>IO: Read and write MPU registers
  IO->>I2C: I2C memory transfers
  App->>Ride: ride_events_init

  loop Cooperative app_start loop
    App->>Telemetry: firmgen_telemetry_poll
    App->>IO: platform_io_poll and read current time
    App->>Sensors: sensors_process
    Sensors->>MPU: Read acceleration when sample interval is due
    MPU->>IO: Read acceleration registers
    IO->>I2C: I2C memory read
    Sensors->>IO: Read DHT22 frame when climate interval is due
    IO->>DHT: Drive and sample PB4
    Sensors->>Sensors: Decode frame and update reading snapshot
    App->>Sensors: Get snapshot

    alt Display ready and splash finished
      alt Acceleration valid
        App->>Ride: Submit acceleration sample
      else Acceleration invalid
        App->>Ride: Submit invalid sample
      end
      App->>Ride: Update event and LED state
      opt Event selection changed
        App->>Display: Set event message
        App->>IO: Log event selection
        IO->>UART: HAL_UART_Transmit
        UART->>Console: Write log bytes
      end
    end

    App->>IO: Set LED state
    IO->>IO: HAL_GPIO_WritePin on PA5
    opt Display initialized
      App->>Display: display_process
      Display->>OLED: Write splash or dashboard page
      OLED->>IO: platform_io_transmit
      IO->>I2C: I2C master transfer
    end
    App->>Telemetry: telemetry_process
    opt Telemetry period elapsed
      Telemetry->>IO: Queue VPD1 CSV record
      IO->>UART: Poll TXE and send telemetry bytes
      UART->>Console: Write telemetry bytes
    end
  end
